The compiler reflows visible rectangles or ring widths instead of deleting source data or reserving empty geometry. Other chart families, interactive drill-down and per-node visibility expressions fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The bounded profile owns one shared value/value coordinate system, 2..8 scatter, bubble, line, area or column series and 2..64 strictly increasing finite X/Y points per series. authoredCompilerBoundaries.feature: native chart trendlines, labels and manual label layouts, plus scalar, literal or fixed-formula custom error bars
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized imported bar/column or line series, including those in categorical combo ChartParts, expose trendlines and local errorBars through setChartSeriesAnalytics. PPJ can insert, reorder, replace, remove or clear trendlines; omission and an empty array both clear the list, which may later be recreated. Scalar and literal custom errorBars can be added, changed, removed by omitting the object, and recreated. Custom plus/minus objects own values aligned with every series point and optional formatCode strings or string grammar tokens; both/plus/minus select the required sides. PpjErrorBarsLifecycleRoundTrips and PpjCustomErrorDataAuthorsAndEditsLiteralOwners verify the four chart profiles, native node order and fresh projection. Each edit affects only its owner in the target ChartPart and preserves other analytics, series identity, data and unrelated package entries. Imported custom plus/minus data can additionally expose an immutable local absolute row/column formula with its complete values cache. Updating those values synchronizes matching numeric cells in a uniquely owned embedded XLSX, including grouped charts. PpjErrorWorkbookSynchronizesCacheAndCells verifies two edits, zero values, fresh projection and unchanged unrelated inner/outer ZIP parts; no-op keeps original bytes and style-only edits keep workbook bytes. Each trendline may own label text, numberFormat, textStyle, fill and line. Ordinary/combo labels support authored output, insertion, replacement, default empty-object presence, deletion and recreation. Text/numberFormat resolve string grammar tokens; omitted text retains automatic equation/R-squared content. PpjTrendlineLabelAuthorsEditsRemovesAndReprojects checks native nodes and fresh projection with ChartPart-only label edits.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The shared ChartSpace codecs own up to sixteen trendlines using six types, polynomial/moving-average constraints, forecast/intercept/display flags and bounded direct line styling. Trendline labels also support ordered rich-text paragraphs, styled literal runs and breaks, paragraph defaults and end styles through the chart text-style profile. Trendline label number formats preserve true/false/omitted sourceLinked state; Office ignores this flag for this owner and no workbook style synchronization is claimed. Trendline labels preserve layout/manual containers, target, edge/factor coordinate and size modes, and finite native fraction values through their full lifecycle. They also own fixed-value/percentage/standard-deviation/standard-error, literal custom errors and fixed-formula custom error value synchronization. Formula creation/deletion/retargeting and source-free formula authoring remain unsupported. Value edits reject missing/shared workbooks, stale caches, overlapping chart consumers, formula cells and unsupported dependency graphs, without emitting an edited file. Other workbook-backed data channels cannot change through this operation. Formula/field/hyperlink trendline text and unsupported text containers, layout extensions, unsupported label effects/extensions, 3D/complex combo semantics and unknown native owners remain source-owned. Local data cannot replace an unprojected owner. Local SVG preview reports chart-error-bars-not-rendered as partial; no host or visual acceptance is claimed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.ppjPath: pages[].elements[].text.paragraphs[].style.defaultText.bold, italic, size, fontFamily, fontFamilyEastAsia, fontFamilyComplexScript, language, kerning, letterSpacing and baseline
authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Ordinary text/shape owners issue independent setTextParagraphStyle fields for direct paragraph default bold, italic, size, fontFamily, fontFamilyEastAsia, fontFamilyComplexScript, language, kerning, letterSpacing and baseline. Explicit booleans and sizes, omission and restoration retain native presence. Size accepts finite values from 1 to 768pt, rounds to native hundredths using nearest-even rounding, and rejects out-of-range sizes. Font family is a nonblank name of at most 255 characters; only a simple direct Latin, East Asian or complex-script font node is replaced or removed. East Asian removal follows explicit source-bound presence and does not regenerate the authored Latin fallback. Language accepts 2..63 characters: an initial 2..8-letter subtag followed by hyphen-separated 1..8-character alphanumeric subtags. Assignment/removal/restoration preserves spelling, altLang and direct run languages; replacement of an unmodeled native lang rejects, while unrelated scalar edits preserve it. Kerning is the minimum font-size threshold in points: finite 0..768, native hundredths with ties-to-even rounding, independent zero/removal/restoration. Direct run kerning and unmodeled native kern survive unrelated default changes; replacing unmodeled kern rejects. LetterSpacing is direct character spacing in points: finite -768..768, native hundredths with ties-to-even rounding, independent zero/removal/restoration. Direct run spacing and unmodeled native spc survive unrelated default changes; replacing unmodeled spc rejects. Baseline is the direct offset in percent: finite -400..400, native integer thousandths with ties-to-even rounding, independent zero/removal/restoration. Direct run baseline and unmodeled native baseline survive unrelated default changes; replacing unmodeled baseline rejects.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Fixed paragraph/run topology is preserved. Removing a defaultText wrapper containing only these scalars clears their direct values while retaining other defaults, direct runs and unknown native state. Unmodeled script-font metadata/children, missing field authority and unrelated defaultText changes fail closed. PpjTextBodyPropertyLifecycleTests verifies source XML/ZIP preservation; placeholder inheritance, table paragraph defaults and host reflow retain their separate boundaries.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized text bodies issue setTextParagraphStyle for fixed-topology tab-stop edits. PPJ positions are expressed in points and lower to the owning paragraph's a:tabLst; noTabStops explicitly removes only that modeled list.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: Only a single direct tab-stop list with bounded left, center, right or decimal alignment is modeled. Inherited list styles, malformed lists, reflow and other paragraph extensions remain source-owned and fail closed.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized fixed-topology text, shape-text and placeholder bodies issue setTextBodyStyle when their direct a:bodyPr state is within the bounded profile. Existing body-property leaves can be changed in place without adding a body or rewriting paragraph/run topology.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The profile owns vertical alignment, wrapping, insets, columns, column gap/direction, vertical-text mode, rotation, overflow, upright, canonical normAutofit percentages, and the bounded direct flatTx z coordinate. Upright supports true/false and source removal; rotation supports signed degrees, explicit zero and source removal through native no_upright/no_rotation operations. ColumnDirection retains explicit left-to-right/right-to-left and supports source removal through no_column_direction. VerticalText retains horizontal/vertical/vertical270 and supports source removal through no_vertical_text_mode. Wrap retains explicit square/none and supports source removal through no_wrap. HorizontalOverflow retains overflow/clip and supports source removal through no_horizontal_overflow_mode independently of verticalOverflow. VerticalOverflow retains overflow/ellipsis/clip and supports source removal through no_vertical_overflow_mode independently of horizontalOverflow. VerticalAlignment retains top/middle/bottom and supports source removal through no_vertical_anchor independently of anchorCenter. ColumnGap retains zero/fractional point values and supports source removal through no_column_spacing independently of columns/direction. Columns retains explicit counts 1..16 and supports source removal through no_columns independently of gap/direction. Margins retain independent left/top/right/bottom point values including zero; edge deletion uses the corresponding no_inset marker, and empty/removed margins deletes all previously projected edges. AutoFit supports explicit none/shrink-text/resize-shape and source choice removal; normalAutoFit supports independent percentage/profile removal while shrink-text remains, through existing native deletion markers. AnchorCenter retains true/false and supports source removal through no_anchor_center in the updated codec, independently of verticalAlignment. ForceAntiAlias retains true/false and supports source removal through no_force_anti_alias in the updated codec; it remains a rendering hint. SpaceFirstLastParagraph retains true/false and supports source removal through no_space_first_last_paragraph in the updated codec while preserving actual paragraph spacing. CompatibleLineSpacing retains true/false and supports source removal through no_compatible_line_spacing in the updated codec while preserving paragraph line spacing. FromWordArt retains true/false and supports source removal through no_from_word_art in the updated codec while preserving text warp. A style owner containing only those fields can be removed. PpjTextBodyPropertyLifecycleTests verifies source lifecycle and unchanged surrounding content. Other deletion, inheritance and unknown/effect-rich bodyPr state retain their source boundaries.

authoredCompilerBoundaries.sourceBound: Recognized fixed-topology table cells expose a structured rich-text text.style object and reuse setTableCellStyle/table.cell.textStyle to patch the existing a:bodyPr leaves.
authoredCompilerBoundaries.reason: The bounded profile owns direct vertical alignment, wrapping, insets, columns, column gap/direction, vertical-text, rotation, overflow, upright, canonical normAutofit percentages, and flatTextZ when those body-property values have a textBoxStyle spelling. Removing previously projected fromWordArt, compatibleLineSpacing, spaceFirstLastParagraph, forceAntiAlias, anchorCenter, autoFit/normalAutoFit state, margins edges, columns, columnGap, verticalAlignment, upright, rotation, columnDirection, verticalText, wrap, horizontalOverflow or verticalOverflow deletes the corresponding direct body attribute; explicit false/zero, left-to-right, horizontal, wrap=none and horizontalOverflow=overflow and verticalOverflow=overflow and verticalAlignment=top and columnGap=0 and columns=1 and margin edges=0 remain values. Removing or emptying margins removes all projected direct insets independently of other body properties. AutoFit deletion removes its choice and dependent profile; percentage deletion retains shrink-text and the other percentage. Explicit none and zero lineSpacingReduction retain native presence. AnchorCenter removal uses the updated codec and preserves verticalAlignment. Deleting projected flatTextZ removes only a canonical flatTx child, preserving explicit zero and signed 32-bit values on restoration; duplicate or noncanonical children fail closed. Deleting projected textWarpPreset with its dependent textWarpAdjustments removes canonical prstTxWarp. With the preset retained, omitted or empty adjustments clear guides; explicit textNoShape and zero/signed guide values remain values. Unknown/duplicate warp subgraphs fail closed. A style owner containing only these fields, flatTextZ or the warp fields can be removed, with compact table text normalization/restoration under fixed native topology. PpjTextBodyPropertyLifecycleTests verifies this table path alongside text owners. Other delete markers, inheritance and unknown bodyPr extensions retain their source boundaries.

Highlight accepts resolved opaque RGB colors/tokens independently of foreground fill and fonts; omission removes it. Direct outer shadows retain RGB/theme color, optional geometry/opacity/alignment/rotation and zero/false presence; omission removes the effect. Chart shadow scaleX/scaleY carry signed ratios at 0.00001 precision and skewX/skewY carry signed degrees at 1/60000 precision with ±90 excluded before and after rounding. Their native absence and zero are independent; ordinary imported shadow proofs keep their no-transform profile. Direct glow reuses required color/radius and optional opacity, including zero radius/alpha and omitted alpha. Inner shadows retain required color and optional blur/distance/angle/opacity without materializing absent attributes. Direct reflection retains optional blur/startOpacity/endOpacity/distance/angle and startPosition/endPosition alpha-ramp fractions, including omitted native positions, an empty effect and explicit zero/defaults. Position fields use 0–1 at native thousandth-percent precision. Scales use native signed Int32 thousandth-percent precision; skew excludes ±90 degrees before and after rounding. Only chart owners accept variable spans and transforms. Glow, inner shadow, outer shadow, reflection and soft edge coexist in native order and can be deleted independently; soft-edge radius uses 0–1000 points with explicit zero and native EMU precision. Other effect graphs retain source ownership. Vector title defaults yield to explicit run language, strike, baseline, capitalization, letterSpacing, kerning, highlight, shadow, glow, innerShadow, reflection and softEdge.
